title: Tiny, cute bicycle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Rear wheel -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='68' r='14' fill='none' stroke='#FF6B9D' stroke-width='3.5'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='68' r='3' fill='#FFE66D'/>
  <!-- Front wheel -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='68' r='14' fill='none' stroke='#FF6B9D' stroke-width='3.5'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='68' r='3' fill='#FFE66D'/>
  <!-- Frame - top tube -->
  <line x1='30' y1='50' x2='62' y2='50' stroke='#4ECDC4' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Frame - seat tube -->
  <line x1='34' y1='50' x2='28' y2='68' stroke='#4ECDC4' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Frame - down tube -->
  <line x1='34' y1='50' x2='50' y2='62' stroke='#4ECDC4' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Frame - chain stay -->
  <line x1='50' y1='62' x2='28' y2='68' stroke='#4ECDC4' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Frame - seat stay -->
  <line x1='62' y1='50' x2='28' y2='68' stroke='#4ECDC4' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Fork -->
  <line x1='62' y1='50' x2='72' y2='68' stroke='#4ECDC4' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Head tube / handlebar stem -->
  <line x1='62' y1='50' x2='66' y2='38' stroke='#FF9F43' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Handlebars -->
  <line x1='58' y1='36' x2='74' y2='36' stroke='#FF9F43' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Handlebar grips -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#FFE66D'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#FFE66D'/>
  <!-- Seat post -->
  <line x1='34' y1='50' x2='32' y2='40' stroke='#FF9F43' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Seat -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='38' rx='8' ry='3.5' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <!-- Pedal crank -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='2.5' fill='#FFE66D'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='58' x2='56' y2='66' stroke='#FFE66D' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Pedals -->
  <rect x='40' y='55' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#FF9F43'/>
  <rect x='54' y='64' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#FF9F43'/>
  <!-- Chain (dashed arc) -->
  <path d='M 50 64 Q 40 72 30 68' fill='none' stroke='#FFE66D' stroke-width='2' stroke-dasharray='2 2'/>
  <!-- Spokes - rear -->
  <line x1='28' y1='55' x2='28' y2='81' stroke='#B388EB' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='15' y1='68' x2='41' y2='68' stroke='#B388EB' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Spokes - front -->
  <line x1='72' y1='55' x2='72' y2='81' stroke='#B388EB' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='59' y1='68' x2='85' y2='68' stroke='#B388EB' stroke-width='1.5'/>
</svg>
